QuestInfo.name: [Murgoth Dungeon] Exploring the Otherworld
QuestInfo.0: You've heard what Murgoth and the Nine-Tailed Fox both have to say. Now the time has come to head to the Otherworld! But you have no idea what the Otherworld is like... Ask Murgoth to fill you in.\r\n\r\n#rThis event quest is available until 23:59:59 on 9/15/2015.#k
QuestInfo.1: Murgoth says that he'll tell you how to bring back his soul and sends you to Lil Murgoth, the keeper of the Otherworld Storage. Ask Lil Murgoth how you can explore  the Otherworld.\r\n\r\n#rThis event quest is available until 11:59 PM on 05/17/2016.#k
QuestInfo.2: Lil Murgoth taught you how to explore the Otherworld.\r\n\r\n#rThis event quest is available until 11:59 PM on 05/17/2016.#k
